The '''Rogue Moon Project''' was an organization founded by [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Shel Jelavan]] in the aftermath of the [[Vindication]]. Seeing how little the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] helped the regular people, Carrick used the money from the cons he ran with [[Marn Hierogryph]] to bring together the families of the victims of the [[Padawan Massacre]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to help refugees and wrongly accused fugitives like Carrick himself used to be.
